verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a collaborative design tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Figma can be deployed on user-controlled infrastructure. The docs cover only Figma-hosted services: the remote MCP server, the REST API, plugins, webhooks and SCIM. None of these amount to self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
